summary: ADR 0081 implements the idle project lifecycle the Runtime previously only accepted as a direction: a periodic sweeper fingerprints durable project state, refuses convergence while work or attention is live, then offboards workers, quiets, and archives the project in that order, derives a summary from stored reports, and publishes one idempotent Runtime notice into the Boss conversation. The idle window is operator configuration (CONCHBASE_PROJECT_IDLE_MS, published as projectConvergence.idleAfterMs).
